def solve(case):
    nodes = case['nodes']
    required_symbols = set(case['required_symbols'])
    # Build mapping
    node_map = {n['id']: n for n in nodes}
    children = {}
    for n in nodes:
        pid = n['parent']
        if pid is not None:
            children.setdefault(pid, []).append(n['id'])
    # Sort nodes by depth descending, then id ascending
    sorted_nodes = sorted(nodes, key=lambda n: (-n['depth'], n['id']))
    retained = set(node_map.keys())
    removed = []
    for n in sorted_nodes:
        nid = n['id']
        if nid not in retained:
            continue
        if not n['removable']:
            continue
        # Check if any retained children
        child_ids = children.get(nid, [])
        has_retained_children = any(cid in retained for cid in child_ids)
        if has_retained_children:
            continue
        # Check required symbols after removal
        temp_retained = retained - {nid}
        symbols_present = {node_map[i]['symbol'] for i in temp_retained}
        if required_symbols.issubset(symbols_present):
            removed.append(nid)
            retained = temp_retained
    retained_node_ids = sorted(retained)
    return {
        "removed_node_ids": removed,
        "retained_node_ids": retained_node_ids
    }
